notes.title: 【Summer Update】Thank you for waiting! The Laboratory map has been added!
notes.content: [h3]You can access the Laboratory map by entering the capsule placed in the Medieval map.ːlunar2019coolpigː[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597776/f032def620a5ff7beeb16f189fcd2e21b2928c0b.png"][/img][/p][p]The Laboratory is dimly lit, so make sure to pick up a flashlight!ː2016roastedː[/p][p]And be careful with the switches and cardboard boxes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597776/30bacc15caa8fb37c87ece8f6912e07fa77c33d6.png"][/img][/p][p]Good luck out there!ːsummer2019hareː[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: The Laboratory map has been added!

notes.title: [Coming Soon] New Map! Summer Update!
notes.content:
[h3]A brand-new laboratory map will be released soon![/h3][p]And yes, it will be a free update![/p][p]All that's left is final testing and adjustments.[/p][p]With the addition of the laboratory map, players will be able to choose between the Medieval Tower and the Laboratory Map from the beginning.
[i]Dark Tower[/i] will remain locked until the Medieval Tower is cleared.[/p][p]Since all the work is being done by a solo developer, I kindly ask for your patience.[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who has purchased the game — I truly appreciate your support.[/p]
